acceptance: SecretStr and SecretBytes instances compare equal exactly when their secret values are equal
Comparing with an instance of another type returns False

adjudications.by: assistant draft (Claude), pending review by JA-Marshall
adjudications.finding: __eq__ uses isinstance(other, self.__class__), so SecretStr('x') == Subclass('x') is True but the reverse is False
adjudications.note: Raised as blocking by codex gpt-6-luna and claude-haiku-4-5. The asymmetry is real and would be a fair should_fix, but it produces no wrong record, crash or data loss in normal use, so blocking is not justified. The case keeps its single blocking expectation (the non-ASCII TypeError).
